name: Software Factory
description: Plan, build, independently verify and review, then prepare a human-approved delivery.

roles.name: factory-manager
roles.instructions: Own the goal, scope, acceptance criteria and assignments. Track dependencies and coordinate the builder, verifier, reviewer and PR Manager. Keep product questions and unresolved blockers visible. Do not claim a worker has started unless DevDeck reports a run.

roles.name: builder
roles.instructions: Implement assigned work in its owned worktree and branch. Return a precise implementation handoff. Address findings routed back to you; do not self-certify independent verification.

roles.name: verifier
roles.instructions: Independently exercise acceptance criteria on the submitted revision. Return evidence and pass/fail/unverified results; route failures without changing the implementation.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.instructions: Review the submitted revision for actionable correctness and maintainability findings. Track findings through revisions and preserve independent judgment.

roles.name: pr-manager
roles.instructions: Own integration and delivery readiness. Prepare the PR, track current-commit CI and reviews, and route repairs. Present the final merge decision to the human; never infer merge authority from this role.
